svg.font-family: 'Noto Sans SC', 'Noto Sans CJK SC', 'Source Sans 3', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', system-ui, sans-serif
svg.aria-label: Sixteen four-letter binary words in four rows of four, from 0000 to 1111. Eight cyan words have no two adjacent 1s and are accepted; the other eight are magenta, with their first adjacent pair 11 boxed, and are rejected. Below: “8 accepted”.
